cases.name: Marissa Mann-Bennett Dawson
cases.about: She worked as a housekeeping attendant at the Greenbrier Resort and was the Owner/Office Manager at Diamond Clear Cleaning LLC.
cases.narrative: On 11/25/2022, her friend found her deceased in her home. She died from major facial trauma. The police stated in their complaint, "[I]t appeared the subject was thrown through the residence and striking what appeared to be her head on several items in the residence."
